item.title: 13 reacciones | Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton responded to her opponent, Vivek Ramaswamy’s ad that features her estranged mother, Donna Arthur, calling her a "liar." Acton’s campaign condemned the ad, and her brother, Philip Stearns, called it a “despicable low.” According to court documents provided by the campaign, Arthur’s now-deceased husband was charged with raping Acton, which she said occurred when she was between 10 and 12 years old. He entered a not guilty plea and left the area while out on bond; the case never went to trial. Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine (R) said on Thursday that he thought the Ramaswamy campaign should take the ad down. Vice President JD Vance and President Trump have defended the ad. | CBS News

item.title: Who should have a say in which species are saved? The California condor offers lessons for a global biodiversity treaty
item.description: In 1987, biologists captured the last free-flying condor to transfer it to captivity, and the largest flying North American bird species was officially declared extinct in the wild. Today, after decades of coordinated efforts and millions of dollars spent on captive breeding and reintroduction efforts, more than 300 condors have been restored to their natural environment. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: El repunte del diésel y la gasolina son dos de los principales focos de presión para Donald Trump y los republicanos ante las elecciones de medio mandato del 3 de noviembre. El problema no se limita a cuánto cuesta llenar el tanque de un camión, sino que repercute también en el precio de los alimentos, el transporte y en la economía en general. Mientras el Gobierno apela a toda clase de medidas, incluyendo un acuerdo con Putin, analistas advierten que el impacto electoral dista de ser marginal. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
